The '''''Nomad''''' was a [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [["Out System" Scout Vessel]] piloted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scouts during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Prior to the [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] the ''Nomad'' sought new locations for the Empire's [[Demophon]] operations.<ref name="EJ" />
